question_or_symptom: Publishing a source symbol catalog can be mistaken for implementing the ROCr/libhsakmt ABI.
observation: The CP-0009 provider exposes manifest, symbol/layout/model metadata, the existing transport handshake, and a generic validated invoke boundary. Shared nm shows 16 sagr_provider_* exports and zero typed hsaKmt/DRM exports; valid unsupported calls return NOT_SUPPORTED without mutating result bytes.
conclusion: An inventory and a typed provider are different gates; the former cannot support a generic ROCr or HIP claim.
decision: Keep CP-0009 metadata-only and require a later typed shim plus daemon operation envelope before claiming provider attach or upper-runtime compatibility.
invalidated_assumptions: A complete name list is equivalent to callable C entry points.
A generic byte-carrier invoke can safely stand in for pointer-bearing ABI functions.
